context: Two news editors plan a feature on regional concerns
purpose: Teach: 県民/中年/日本国/同志/アラブ/モンゴル/高価/形状

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 次の特集ですが、地方の声を拾いたくて、県民アンケートの結果をまとめてみました。
lines.en: For the next feature, I wanted to capture local voices, so I compiled the results of a prefectural resident survey.
lines.style: Polite junior pitching a story idea with documents

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: いいですね。回答者の層を見ると、中年世代が一番不安を感じているみたいです。
lines.en: Sounds good. Looking at the respondent demographics, it seems middle-aged people feel the most anxiety.
lines.style: Measured senior editor reviewing data calmly aloud

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: ええ、日本国民全体の傾向ともずれていなくて、この切り口は読者に響くと思います。
lines.en: Yes, it doesn't diverge from the trend among the Japanese public as a whole, so I think this angle will resonate with readers.
lines.style: Confident pitch backed by comparative national data

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 海外の事例も並べたいですね。同志社の先生に、地方再生の比較研究を頼めるか聞いてみます。
lines.en: I'd like to line up overseas examples too. I'll ask a professor at Doshisha whether they can take on a comparative study of rural revitalization.
lines.style: Senior expanding scope with concrete expert contact

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 助かります。例えばアラブ諸国の事例なんかは、日本との対比が利きそうです。
lines.en: That helps. Cases from Arab countries, for instance, would probably contrast well with Japan.
lines.style: Junior building on the senior's suggestion with one example

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: モンゴルの遊牧地域の話も面白いですよ。ただ現地取材は高価なので、まずはオンラインで進めましょう。
lines.en: The story of Mongolia's nomadic regions is interesting too. But on-site coverage is expensive, so let's start online.
lines.style: Senior adding one more angle and addressing budget realistically

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: そうですね。誌面のレイアウトも少し変えて、地図とグラフを見開きで配置すると分かりやすいかも。
lines.en: Right. If we tweak the page layout a bit and place the map and graphs across a spread, it might be easier to follow.
lines.style: Junior proposing a visual design refinement collaboratively

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: いいですね。グラフは円や棒など、データに合った形状を選んでください。
lines.en: Good idea. For the graphs, please pick the shape — circle, bar, etc. — that fits each dataset.
lines.style: Senior giving a concrete design instruction about chart shapes

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: それで行きましょう。今週中にラフを上げて、来週の編集会議に出します。
lines.en: Let's go with that. I'll have a rough draft up this week and bring it to next week's editorial meeting.
lines.style: Junior wrapping up with a concrete deadline commitment
